description: Delete a list of S3 objects as a Dagster asset -- mirrors Airflow's S3DeleteObjectsOperator.

keys.label: Keys
keys.description: Static list of keys to delete. Set this or keys_asset_key (not both).

keys_asset_key.label: Keys Asset Key
keys_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key whose materialized value is a list of keys to delete (e.g. the output of s3_list_keys_asset). Set this or keys (not both).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered aws_s3_resource. When set, credentials/session come from that resource instead of a bare boto3.client('s3', region_name=...).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool (e.g. Airflow's `pool` -- a fixed number of slots shared across every asset/op using the same pool name). The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level (dagster.yaml's concurrency: pools:, or the Dagster+ UI), not here.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Kill the wait and fail the run if the deletes haven't finished after this many seconds. Enforced via a background-thread wrapper -- the underlying boto3 call(s) may continue running past the deadline (Python threads can't be forcibly killed); this bounds the step's wait, not the call itself.

name: S3DeleteObjectsAsset
